content.short: Bluesky focuses on developing the AT Protocol to create a web3-based internet.
content.description: Backed by Twitter founder Jack Dorsey, Bluesky aims to redefine the social internet by reducing data silos across online apps. The Bluesky app runs on the Authenticated Transport Protocol (AT), a decentralized social media framework designed to be open source and interoperable. Through AT, users can interact with multiple applications within one ecosystem, supporting cross-service conversations and seamless data portability without being locked into a single platform.
